evidence_required: Written answer (2–5 sentences) that names the mechanism, not just the term.

marking.criterion: Correct definition: once or many applications yield the same end state (not 'safe')
A naturally idempotent ORION operation (e.g. set MTU 9000, gNMI replace of a QoS map)
A non-idempotent ORION operation (firmware flash + reset, reboot, append, IP allocation)
Retry-safety technique: check running state before acting, read back, idempotency key per change/target

title: Idempotent operations
